description: This file defines the TempNameExpression class, a part of Twig's internal expression node hierarchy, used for handling temporary variable names within Twig templates.

classes.name: TempNameExpression
classes.description: Represents a temporary name expression node in Twig's internal expression syntax tree, managing variable names used during template compilation and parsing.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the TempNameExpression with a name or index, handling reserved names, boolean/null literals, and deprecation warnings.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the expression into PHP code, generating a variable name to be used during template rendering.
